notes:
Breaks, a Manager tab and the Dance Counter role.

- STOP ALL STAGES (next to NEXT): every stage holds for a break; RESUME or NEXT puts the same girls back up and the set timer carries on.
- Break at the end of the rotation (turn it on for the night under + ADD GIRLS): the stages stop by themselves when everyone has had her turn.
- Manager settings have their own Manager tab (DJ screen and iPads), hidden until a manager unlocks.
- Dance Counter role: no house fees or report. The Dance Counter button on the DJ screen only shows for a manager.
- The set timer can also flash; the Info button is gone from the iPads; the Sugar Shack logo on the screens.
